summary: Neris finds a forked physical stress trace that the clean Archive figures omit.
Cael stages an Archive entry and obtains a flat copy of the red ledger without damaging the lock.
Tovan hears a seven-strike west-arcade signal as eight because of the returning echo.
Binding evidence shows the absent ledger folio was removed while blank.
Yara gives Tovan the future-looking ferry token to carry toward Neris.
Neris reverses the survey lens and corrects the apparently contradictory bearing side.
Tovan reconstructs Pel's delayed message from knots and separates the delay from malicious intent.
Tovan sees Janek's right-hand grip fail during Bellhouse rehearsal.
Neris confronts Orra's technically narrow denial and discloses her own old audit alteration.
The civic calendar and ferryman evidence connect Hal's token to his planned departure.
Neris learns that Merrin was Tovan's retired courier alias.
Side light on the original ledger proves Cael's flat copy cannot preserve indentation evidence.
Neris combines lock, route, bell, and authority constraints into a dependency-ordered warning plan.
Tovan asks retired couriers and district workers to form a consent-based readiness chain.
Tovan refuses Cael's plan to seize the carriage and defines his own consent boundary.
A controlled cart test links repeated iron-shod starts to progressive west-bearing crazing.
Orra publicly admits excluding two deviations while Neris publishes an honest timing range.
The maintenance roll narrows the missing interval and Tovan transfers the master key under explicit stop conditions.
On king-tide morning, the public evidence ledger and route receipts trigger the coordinated warning and bearing unload.
After hearing the abort condition, Cael chooses to wait; Pel completes the signal, the repair succeeds, and Tovan retires the key.
